description: Given a description of the topics discussed in a client meeting, returns a private coaching note for the advisor (the cognitive bias the client's language suggests and how to approach it), a separate ready-to-send client follow-up message with a term, a sourced fact and a suggested next module, and a compliance self-check of that message for anecdotal framing, suitability language and missing disclosures. The coaching note is written for the advisor, not the client.

topics_discussed.description: Free-text description of what came up in the meeting, in the advisor's own words

name: advisor.post_meeting_followup
title: Generate a Post-Meeting Education Follow-Up
